Sustainability

Better performance begins with thoughtful design.

We explore passive strategies and responsible material and resource choices before discussing technology options.

No measured energy, water, cost or comfort performance is claimed. Outcomes require project-specific calculations and evidence.
01

Shade & orientation

Study site orientation, roof overhangs, verandas and screened openings to manage direct sun and create comfortable transitions.

02

Natural ventilation

Consider cross-ventilation, high-level openings and courtyard effects alongside site conditions and specialist input.

03

Daylight & material

Use room placement, controlled daylight and suitable material choices to shape a comfortable interior environment.

04

Energy & water options

Evaluate solar generation, storage, rainwater capture, metering and reuse according to site feasibility and professional design.

Evidence before claims

Climate response is specific to its site.

Local climate, orientation, materials, occupancy, construction quality and system performance all matter. TRIXX will publish measured results only when supported by verified project data or clearly stated calculations.
